members.algorithm: Break ties away from best-fit by scoring bins to intentionally balance residual space after placement, spreading items rather than hugging the tightest gap.
members.code:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Return one priority for each feasible bin.

    ``bins`` contains remaining capacities after filtering bins that cannot
    hold ``item``.  The evaluator selects the first maximum priority and
    opens a new bin when the array is empty.
    """
    residual = bins - item
    mean_residual = residual.mean() if residual.size else 0.0
    return -np.abs(residual - mean_residual)
